crossRefs.keyword: They go up, etc. or, The mountains ascend, the valleysdescend

translations.web: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
translations.bsb: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them—
translations.kjv: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded
translations.asv: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.
